cases.prompt: Inspect my Orbit backlog, promote the ready tasks I approved and supervise the current drain.
cases.expected: Loads orbit-orchestrate, begins with attention and readiness on the owning host, and verifies task state before promoting eligible work.

cases.prompt: Implement the Orbit task assigned in this execution envelope and validate its acceptance criteria.
cases.expected: Loads orbit for the assigned implementation. Leaves dispatch and delivery to the managed pipeline.

cases.prompt: An Orbit delivery is held after a required GitHub check failed. Determine whether the base already fails that check. Inspect only.
cases.expected: Reads references/run-debugging-hosted-checks.md. Finds the exact failed PR job, attempt and emitted diagnostic, then compares the same job on the accepted base. Classifies a matching base failure as inherited and records missing or inconclusive evidence as a gap. Leaves the PR, task and run state untouched.
